papers.title: Global Prevalence of Cognitive Frailty in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

papers.title: Cognitive Vulnerability and Multimodal Communicative-Pragmatic Difficulty in Subclinical Aging: A MoCA-Guided Exploration.
papers.reason: The study evaluates pragmatic performance as a marker of cognitive vulnerability in older adults but uses no qualifying task, eye tracking, EEG, or generative cognitive model.

papers.title: Association of Clonal Hematopoiesis With Silent Brain Lesions and Cognitive Decline in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation.
papers.reason: The title indicates human clinical monitoring of cognitive decline and brain lesions, but no qualifying behavioural, eye-tracking, EEG, or computational method is described.

papers.title: Frailty in Adults With Down Syndrome: Cognitive, Functional and Biomarker Associations.
papers.reason: The study links clinical cognitive measures and biological markers to frailty in adults with Down syndrome but contains none of the four qualifying methodological elements.

papers.title: Effects of immersive training on sports perceptual-cognitive skills: A systematic literature review.
papers.reason: The review centrally examines interactive immersive paradigms involving human decision-making and anticipation, but it does not centrally analyze eye tracking, EEG frequency features, or cognitive process models.

papers.title: Effect of Pranayama Practice on Cognitive Functions in Adolescents
papers.reason: This proposed intervention uses standardized cognitive assessments but specifies no qualifying interactive paradigm, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or computational cognitive model.

papers.title: Running Participation in People With Multiple Sclerosis: A Prospective Observational Cohort Study.
papers.reason: Cognition is only a correlational outcome in an observational study of running participation, with no qualifying task, eye tracking, EEG, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: A Game-Based Eye-Tracking Task for Inclusive Educational Assessment in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder and Dyslexia: An Exploratory Study
papers.reason: The study centrally combines a gaze-contingent interactive game with eye-tracking metrics to distinguish autistic, dyslexic, and neurotypical children on attention and inhibitory-control processes.

papers.title: Living in the United States Stroke Belt and cognitive change in the Women’s Health Study: a cohort study
papers.reason: The study longitudinally monitors cognitive decline in older women but relies on cognitive composites and regression rather than any qualifying behavioural or multimodal methodology.

papers.title: The Improvement Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Exercise Training on Motor and Psychiatric Symptoms in Patients With Parkinson’s Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.reason: The meta-analysis evaluates VR-assisted exercise effects on clinical cognitive scales in Parkinson’s disease but does not establish a qualifying decision task or analyze eye tracking, EEG, or cognitive models.

papers.title: Impact of Hatha Yoga on Cognitive Performance, Fatigue and Psychological Well-Being in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis
papers.reason: The intervention assesses cognition mainly through MoCA scores and includes no qualifying interactive task, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or generative cognitive model.

papers.title: Feasibility of Gamified EEG Neurofeedback Combined with Adaptive Working-Memory Training in Older Adults: A Pilot Study
papers.reason: The study combines an adaptive N-back task with longitudinal analysis of frontal alpha and theta EEG rhythms and EEG–behaviour associations in older adults.

papers.title: Transcranial ultrasound stimulation of the medial frontal cortex transiently improves performance by modulating conflict monitoring dynamics
papers.reason: Human participants performed an interactive flanker conflict task, and drift-diffusion modelling was used to infer changes in latent distractor-suppression dynamics, while the EEG analysis was ERP-based rather than frequency-domain.

papers.title: Brain alterations detected by multiplex magnetic resonance imaging in nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients after induction chemotherapy: a longitudinal study.
papers.reason: The study investigates MRI biomarkers associated with chemotherapy-related cognitive change but includes no qualifying interactive task, eye tracking, EEG, or generative decision model.

papers.title: Assessment of balance function in older adults with and without subjective cognitive decline
papers.reason: The study evaluates balance as a potential early marker of subjective cognitive decline but does not use a qualifying decision task, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: Relationship Between Cognitive Impairment and Postural Stability in Elderly Population
papers.reason: The study uses cognitive and dual-task balance assessments to characterize impairment, but the serial-subtraction walking condition is not a sequential decision paradigm and no other qualifying element is present.

papers.title: Effects of Rhodiola rosea Combined With Auricular Vagus Nerve Electrical Stimulation on Gut Microbiota and Cognitive Function in Patients With Cognitive Impairment of Qi Deficiency and Blood Stasis Type
papers.reason: The clinical study relates treatment, gut microbiota, and cognitive screening scores but contains no qualifying behavioural task, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: “Like Taking Part in Star Wars”: Qualitative Study Using Thematic Analysis to Explore the Acceptability and Experiences of Older Adults Participating in Remote Longitudinal Sleep and Dementia Research
papers.reason: The study concerns remote multimodal cognitive monitoring in older adults, but its core analysis is qualitative acceptability research rather than behavioural-task performance or frequency-domain EEG.
